subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should this issue be considered fixed by a dedicated `skills lint` diagnostic surface, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, `skills.status`, and Web Skills views also expose skipped SKILL.md diagnostics before closure?
rationale: Current main lacks all requested diagnostics, and the open PR implements a plausible lint-first path but does not fully settle the issue's requested status/Web visibility or diagnostic redaction boundary.

options.title: Accept lint-first with explicit follow-up
options.body: Land a repaired lint-first PR and keep or open a narrower follow-up for normal status/Web diagnostics if maintainers do not want that scope in the same change.

options.title: Require status/UI diagnostics now
options.body: Hold the implementation until skipped-candidate diagnostics are threaded through normal CLI/status/Web surfaces as part of the same fix.

options.title: Narrow to docs and authoring guidance
options.body: Treat runtime visibility as out of scope and only document SKILL.md formatting, accepting that malformed local skills remain invisible without a dedicated command.

recommendation.title: Accept lint-first with explicit follow-up
recommendation.body: Land a repaired lint-first PR and keep or open a narrower follow-up for normal status/Web diagnostics if maintainers do not want that scope in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills loader/status work and release ownership make this the best available routing candidate for deciding the accepted diagnostic surface.
